Use case: photorealistic-natural.
Asset type: ONE photographic architectural storyboard reference for an interactive luxury property homepage, landscape 16:9, no UI or lettering.
Primary request: Establish the SINGLE coherent conceptual residence for Strong Properties, Kumasi, Ghana. A beautiful believable contemporary two-storey tropical luxury residence photographed from the front exterior, at human eye height from its approach, with an understated axial entrance set in the centre. The front entrance is OPEN, revealing a softly lit ivory-stone hallway with dark walnut interior door frames far inside. Modern rectilinear architecture, warm ivory limestone walls, dark walnut details, muted champagne brass, large carefully shaded windows, paved natural stone walkway, restrained tropical planting suited to Kumasi. A glamorous but lived-in architectural photograph with natural material detail, not a glossy computer rendering. Late-afternoon warm sidelight, soft shadows, blue-grey sky. Wide enough to understand the house, centred entrance is the camera's destination. Keep doorway and approach on centre axis for future image-based transitions. House fills most of frame, small useful quiet area in the lower left for later editable typography. Do not show any words, banners, logos, UI, people, cars, fake listing evidence or awards. No swimming pool in front of the entrance. No fantasy cantilever or surreal geometry. This is conceptual brand architecture, not a real advertised property.
